opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court, of Oklahoma. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 358 U. S. 807.) The motion of the State of Oklahoma for leave to file brief, as amicus curiae, is granted.

Mr. Justice Clark took no part in the consideration or decision' of this motion.
